userProfileModal.title: Profile
userProfileModal.name: Name
userProfileModal.noMemberships: You are not a member of any organization.
userProfileModal.leaveHelp: Leaving removes your access to that organization. If you are its only org admin, promote someone else first.
userProfileModal.patHelp: A personal access token signs you in from tools that cannot open a browser — psql, a Neo4j client, an Arrow Flight or gRPC client, an MCP client, or a script. It acts as you, in this organization.
userProfileModal.patMintedHelp: Copy this token now. It is stored only as a hash, so it cannot be shown again.
userProfileModal.patNone: You have no tokens in this organization.
userProfileModal.deleteAccountHelp: This removes your Provisa account and your membership of every organization. Organizations you belong to, and everything registered in them, are kept.
